news.text: #Juve At The Crossroads: No More Chances LeftEuropa League: at 6:45 PM the #Rennes trap, 3-5-2 with #Kolo and #Woltemade[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#SPALLETTI: "THE TEAM IS WITH ME" PROVE ITAt 6:45 PM, #Juve-#RennesThe bianconeri are called to a test of responsibility and pride. "I asked them to tell me honestly what they think: I felt they were on my side". #Kolo alongside #Woltemade: "Tensions? Yes, but resolved". Spotlights on #Cambiaso and #Bremer.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🎙 Guido Vaciago spoke on TS Live about the future of Luciano #Spalletti and the current state of #Juventus:#ELKANN'S CONFIDENCE"We reported a piece of news that was already in the air, but for which we received highly authoritative confirmation: John #Elkann reaffirmed full confidence in #Spalletti.Or rather, intact confidence. The defeat against #Lazio did not change the relationship of trust between the ownership and the coach.This doesn't mean they are satisfied with the start of this league campaign, but rather that the ownership is convinced about #Spalletti and moving forward with him.He believes that only with a minimum of continuity can something good and solid be built.It is not the

🇧🇷 Gleison #Bremer wants to continue wearing the #Juventus shirt. There are no confirmations of any potential negotiation for the defender's transfer to #BayerLeverkusen as rumored, as the player's desire is to remain at the bianconero club. In the difficult period that #Spalletti's team is going through, #Bremer wants to stay to prove his value on the pitch and will not let himself be distracted by external rumors.To date, his entourage and the player are not considering leaving #Juve.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]
🔴 Probable #Juventus lineup: Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Kelly; Kalulu, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners, Celik; McKennie; Woltemade, Kolo Muani.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

Spalletti and Kolo Muani speak ahead of Juventus-Stade RennaisThe Men’s First Team return to UEFA Europa League action with a home match against French side Stade Rennais F.C. on Thursday night.Ahead of the 18:45 CEST kick-off at the Allianz Stadium, Luciano Spalletti and Randal Kolo Muani spoke to the press.RANDAL KOLO MUANI“We had a tough match at the weekend, but it’s great to have another chance straight away to put it behind us, look ahead and show what we’re capable of on the pitch. Tomorrow we’ll have to give it our all to put in a good performance. After the last match, the captain spoke to the team; it was a positive discussion. 👀 At #Juventus there was no blitz, no emergency summit, nor any technical meeting to plan the future after the heavy defeat at the Allianz against #Gattuso's #Lazio. There is also no summit scheduled.The ownership's stance has not changed one bit: confidence remains completely intact in Luciano #Spalletti's technical project.The ownership strongly reaffirmed this from more than 7000 km away in Detroit, where John #Elkann, CEO of #Exor, was yesterday for business matters unrelated to football.#Elkann's photo on the bench alongside #Spalletti, before the home match against the #NextGen on August 17, recalls a mutual promise: to bring #Juve back to being #Juventus.[@tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

🏟️ A sold-out is very close for #JuveRennes. Despite the difficult moment, the bianconero public responds by showing up.[Mirko Di Natale]

⚪⚫ I wouldn't want to report this too loudly, but it's an open secret that Simone #Inzaghi is a manager who is well-liked and highly appreciated by the ownership. 😅🤫The interest is nothing new, but dates back at least 14/15 months ago. And a few chats have already taken place.[Mirko Di Natale]

JOHN: CONFIDENCE IN #SPALLETTIA strong signal arrives from #Juve's ownership.#Elkann from the USA clears the bianconero landscape of the #Conte misunderstanding: moving forward with Lucio, convinced that the coach and the team will know how to reverse the course. Sabatini: "Lucio is still the right man, but this is the most difficult mission of his life. He must use simplicity to bring the players closer to his ideals of perfection". Tomorrow against #Rennes here is again #Kolo-#Woltemade, #Çelik returns to the right.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇮🇹⁉️ #Juventus is targeting #Raimondo, but #Frosinone has no intention of letting him go in January. The bianconeri could try to beat the competition in the winter, but even #Bologna - the club that owns his contract - might also prefer to postpone everything until the summer. If he continues like this, his price tag could increase, also attracting interest from foreign clubs.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙💪 #Spalletti wants to reanimate #Juventus: he spoke out, demanding a different mentality and attitude. They are starting fresh with a tactical revision: three at the back. The 4-2-3-1 is weakened by the absence of a center-forward capable of leading the line on his own. However, the signals must come primarily from the attitude. The coach reiterated his full confidence to the squad: everyone has always worked with the utmost seriousness and commitment.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 #Juventus is going through a phase of deep difficulty, but confirms its trust in Luciano #Spalletti and is not concretely evaluating any alternatives.The criticisms directed at the coach are considered excessive.The immediate priority is to reunite the environment, overcome internal tensions and regain serenity and results.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

👀 Gleison #Bremer apologized to Luciano #Spalletti and his #Juventus teammates upon returning to training.The Brazilian defender admitted that he let himself be carried away by the anger of the moment, following his declarations to Sky Sport in the post-game after the #Lazio match.#Spalletti reaffirmed his line of firmness in front of the group and demanded individual self-criticism first.The outburst from the defender, who wears the captain's armband in the absence of Manuel #Locatelli, did not please the management at all.#Bremer will receive a fine, which he has already accepted.Guglielmo #Vicario, on the other hand, called for responsibility: "We have to stay focused on the history of th
